To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the herbicides ronstar and stomp applied pre emergence at 0.50 and 0.25 kg a.i. per ha respectively, followed by tolkan, tribunil, fusilade, flex, and hand weeding were the most effective in controlling weeds in chickpeas.

the pre emergence herbicides ronstar and stomp and the post emergence herbicides fusilade and flex are the most effective in weed control and yield enhancement in chickpea and are the most profitable to the farmer.
the herbicide ronstar and stomp applied at the rate of 2.5 and 2.0 L ha 1, respectively, gave the highest yield and net return.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the efficacy of different herbicides to control the weeds in chickpeas.
the economic efficacy of herbicides for weed control in chick pea.
weed control in chick peas, a crop which is not widely cultivated in the country.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the herbicide application alone or in combination is more economical than hand weeding in chickpea.
ronstar followed by stomp, tribunil and tokan are the most efficient pre emergence herbicides for chickpea, while fusilade followed by flex are most efficient post emergence herbicides.
ronstar and stomp applied at recommended rates were the most economical and effective herbicides for chickpea weed control.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the herbicide ronstar and stomp were most efficient and economical to control weeds in Chickpea.
the best economic returns were obtained from ronstar followed by stomp.

ronstar, Stomp and tribunil applied alone or in combination with each other were the best herbicides for chickpea crop, while the post emergent herbicide fusilade was the most effective and economically viable herbicide to be applied alone or in mixture with flex.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the farmers should use ronstar or stomp alone or in combination with tolkin or tribunil as a pre emergence herbicides and fusilade as post emergence herbicides at the recommended rates to get highest yield and net return.
pre emergence herbicides are the most efficient and cost effective in controlling weeds and increasing chickpea yield.
pre and post emergence weed control measures are equally effective in chickpea.
